scope: Registered artificial static three-node family with fixed edge shape and constants; one shared unknown c and free event memory initial states; 11 causal theta/omega observations over 100 ms and exact endpoint p. Two noiseless shared batches are the primary accuracy claim; noisy inputs are diagnostics only.

root_decisions.supported_claim: Both preregistered noiseless shared batches recover c within absolute error .01 and pass numerical qualification.
root_decisions.working_parameter_probe: Port-complete four-test weak regression with event-memory elimination; unconstrained discrete linear diagnostic only.

five_axes.optimization_adequacy: supported for the saved unconstrained discrete linear subproblem; unknown for the continuous noisy inverse problem
five_axes.mechanism_testability: Port omission bias and single-test degeneracy distinguished; relative rank does not establish physical information under noise.
five_axes.effect_and_confirmation: Two noiseless shared batches meet the .01 target; one paired noise direction per artificial trajectory gives no noise coverage guarantee.

next_question: Calibrate information strength relative to theta/omega observation noise, allowing no definite parameter output when data are insufficient. Freeze calibration and new-direction checking prospectively; do not infer thresholds from current false estimates.
